title.description: Title to show up at the top of the report. Defaults to a title including the asset name(s).

fileName.description: File name for the Pdf report. If not specified, defaults to title + timestamp.

directory.description: Directory for Pdf report. If not specified, defaults to value from {@link ReliabilityReportConfig#reportDirectory}.

timeRange.description: Time range to use for asset summary components.

modelStatuses.description: Model statuses to include models for within the {@link timeRange} for the asset.

modelReportSpec.description: Spec type to configure user preferences in the nested {@link ReliabilityMlModelReport}s.

project.description: Used to filter the {@link ReliabilityAsset#currentModelRelations} for the selected {@link ReliabilityAsset}

title: Spec type to configure user preferences in a {@link ReliabilityAsset} report.
name: ReliabilityAssetReportSpec
